payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerates all possible step lengths l from modular constraints derived from a and b, then for each computes the number of stops using LCM.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over a small set of residue classes and generates all valid l less than n*k, effectively performing a complete search over the reduced space. No backtracking is used, but it is the closest subtype within the required family.
